author: Gmelin, 1789

months.note: 국내 기록은 대부분 5월 하순~6월 초 서남해 섬에 몰려 있고 7월까지 이어지며(9월·12월 기록도 한 번씩 있다), 번식지에서는 5~8월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 우리나라에서는 미조로 알려져 있고, 제주도 용담동에 서식한다. 논, 갈대밭, 습지에서 홀로 또는 암수가 함께 지내며, 얕은 물속이나 진흙 위를 느릿느릿 걸으며 물고기, 개구리 따위를 잡아먹는다. 갈대밭이나 물 위 수초 줄기 사이에 풀잎과 갈대 줄기로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 알을 5~6개 정도 낳는다. 세계적으로는 일본 오키나와를 비롯한 동아시아에 분포하며, 한쪽 날개 길이는 14~15cm이다.

points.en: single brown stripe down the throat

sexes.male: 몸 윗면이 붉은 갈색이고, 번식기에는 눈앞이 붉어진다.
sexes.female: 몸 윗면이 수컷보다 짙은 갈색이고, 뚜렷한 검은 갈색 세로무늬가 여러 줄 있다.

young: 어른 암컷과 비슷하나 몸 윗면이 더 갈색이고 날개덮깃에 모래빛 반점과 가는 줄무늬가 많으며, 앞목과 아랫면의 짙은 갈색 세로줄무늬가 더 굵고 뚜렷하다.

similar.how: 큰덤불해오라기는 날 때 검은 날개깃과 옅은 담황색 날개덮깃이 대비되지만, 열대붉은해오라기 수컷은 날개깃까지 온통 계피색이다.

art.subject: Cinnamon Bittern (Ixobrychus cinnamomeus), adult male in summer: crown, hindneck, back, wings and tail uniform bright cinnamon-rufous, with no black in the wings or crown; sides of the neck and underparts paler cinnamon-buff, yellowish-buff on the belly; a single dark brown stripe down the centre of the throat and foreneck; bill yellow with a darker culmen; bare lores yellow, flushed red in the breeding season; yellow iris; legs greenish-yellow.
art.pose: walking slowly over mud in shallow water, hunting
art.scene: Korean rice paddies and reedy wetland on Jeju; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing in shallow water: uniform cinnamon-rufous upperparts and wings, paler cinnamon-buff underparts, single dark brown stripe down the throat and foreneck, yellow bill, greenish-yellow legs
adult female, side view standing: darker, duller brown upperparts, buff underparts with several bold blackish-brown stripes down the foreneck and breast, yellow bill, greenish-yellow legs
breeding male, head detail in profile: red-flushed bare lores, yellow iris, yellow dagger-shaped bill with a darker culmen, cinnamon crown, dark brown throat stripe
art.build: Small, compact bittern, 40cm, a little bigger than a Yellow Bittern and far smaller than a Black-crowned Night Heron; usually hunched with the neck drawn in, stretching it upward when alarmed. Bill straight, dagger-shaped, about as long as the head. Legs medium length, greenish-yellow, with long toes for clutching reeds. At rest the wingtips reach the tail tip; tail very short. In flight the whole wing, including the flight feathers, is uniform cinnamon, with no black.
avoid: Do not paint black flight feathers or a black crown; those are Yellow Bittern (Ixobrychus sinensis). This species' wings are entirely cinnamon.
Do not streak the male's back; the male's upperparts are plain.
Do not paint long neck plumes, white plumage or a curved bill.
Do not make it large and long-necked like a Grey Heron; it is small and compact.
